en: That's okay, Ashida-san. You're the exception.
Heh. Thanks, Shinada. It was good to see you again after all this time. Take care.
Yeah, you too.
I'm sorry! I can do better, I swear!
It's not your fault, Shinada. It wasn't because you couldn't hit. I just couldn't pitch you anything good.
But you still have regrets about retiring. Why give up just based on this?

Because that's how I made up my mind. Gotta make a decision
somehow, so... There's no need for you to apologize.
Ashida-san...
I'm sorry for dragging you into this. But it's all over now.
At my age, coming back as a batting pitcher was always a long shot. I knew that, but I let myself dream.
I should have realized long ago that the game has passed me by.
I don't care what anyone says, you were always the greatest batting pitcher... No, not "were." You still are.
Even if you were to deny it yourself, you can't change my mind.
It's all right, Shinada. It's over. But thanks.
It was good to see you after all this time. That makes this visit worthwhile. Take care.
(Ashida-san... Thank you for everything you've done!)
Hey there, awesome batter man.
Kotetsu. How many times are you gonna pop outta nowhere?
As many times as it takes! Now, let's have you take on Mikasa-kun again. Ten pitches each, get the most hits to win.
I'll go up first again.
Okay, going in. Thanks again for doing this!
Whew... Seven hits... Thought I could do better.
Tie goes to Mikasa, right? That means I need eight to win.
Okay! Time to show my stuff!
(There's a diligent kid. Swinging pretty good, too.)
Uh... Did you want something?
No, you just look like you're training hard. What team are you on?
I'm a freshman at Kinei High. I've always wanted to practice against a pitching machine, but I can't afford it.
Hah, as much as I'd like to treat you to a round, I don't have any spare cash, either.
Then allow me to do the honors.
Oh, hey! The guy with the blog!
Oh, what's up, Kotetsu?
I'm actually a Kinei High grad. I was on their baseball team, too.
The kid's Mikasa-kun. He's a freshman, but with big hopes on him⑬he's already batting leadoff. How'd you like to square off against him?
And just how do you suggest I go about doing that?
Base it on batting average. You both go up against the same pitching machine for ten throws each. Whoever gets the most hits wins.
From what I hear, Mikasa-kun has an on-base percentage that's out of this world. I think it could be a good match.
All so you can blog about it?
What, I see no harm in that. I am paying for the both of you. But my offer's null and void if you don't play, though.
Could I ask you to play, too? Going against a machine would sure be a lot nicer than swinging around my bat all day.
And I just realized! You're the awesome batter Kotetsu-san writes about on his blog! I would love to watch and learn from seeing how you bat.
Man... That's pretty flattering to hear in this day and age. How can I say no?
Good, so it's on. Let's have Mikasa-kun go first.
Ten pitches, then?
By the way, Mikasa-kun, what's your usual batting average?
A little over five hundred. But against a pitching machine, I should do even better.
Kinei High's pride is on the line. Don't you go losing, now!
Yes, sir! I'll do my best.
So I gotta hit at least eight to win?
Yep. If it's a draw, Mikasa gets the win. Is that okay with you?
Sure, whatever. I mean, what's in it for me if I win?
Nothing. Of course, if you were to lose, that news will be broadcast all over the world from my blog.
Heh, I get it. Then I better not screw up.
...So it turns out my arm will be just fine. The doctor said there wasn't any bone damage. All I have to do is rest up for a while, and I can go back to playing.
That's great to hear. You had me pretty worried.
If you hadn't come by, I don't want to think about how it would've ended. We seriously can't thank you enough.
Heh, well, when you get healthy enough to hold a bat again, you should come back. You need to train for those nationals, right?
Will you let me challenge you again?
Sure. Whenever you like.
Oh, by the way, my teammates gave me something for you.
They thought you should have this.
Heh, and I assume those boys had enough of partying with random girls?
I would hope so. They said they'll concentrate on training like never before.
How about that? Maybe this all worked out for the best. I'll expect big things from you in the spring.
Then I'll be sure not to let you down! Thank you again!
There! Done!
Wow... That was something else. You really are an amazing batter.
Yep, I've got an eye for these things, after all.
Heh, you're so full of it.
Full of win, I think you mean! Anyway, I have to write this up, so, gotta jet!
He really is obsessed with that blog of his, isn't he?
Maybe 'cause he found a really awesome batter? After seeing you put in work out there, I know I need to train a lot harder.
Gee, you're dedicated. Wait a second, didn't Kinei High do pretty good at the fall regionals a little while ago?
Yeah. We have a pretty good shot at making it to Koshien for the spring nationals. That's why I've been going at it so hard.
Oh, yeah, the spring nationals... I guess it would be around the end of next month when the team selections are announced?
Yup. Our teachers are saying we should have a good team going in. As long as there're no hiccups, we basically have it in the bag.
*beeeeep*
Oh, sorry, it's my phone.
Hello? It's Mikasa. Oh, Koichi? Yeah. Uh-huh?
What!? Why the heck... Are you serious!?
(Sounds like trouble.)
Okay, got it. The parking lot on Goshiki Street. I'm on my way!
What's up? Anything the matter?
No! Nothing! I'm sorry, I have to go!
(That sure didn't seem like nothing... It was the parking lot on Goshiki Street, right? Better go see what's going on.)
Gah! Couldn't do it!
Well, that was disappointing. Or maybe Mikasa-kun's just that good.
Oh, I don't know about that...
If you'd like, we could do this again. This could be an interesting bit for my blog.
Okay, we got it! We won't mess with Kinei High's team again! Let us go!
Oh man... You really saved our hides just now!
Mikasa-kun. You need to see a doctor, now.
If there's any bone damage, you might not heal up in time for Koshien.
What're we gonna do, dude? If we don't do something, our guys are gonna get it for sure...
How'd they get into this mess in the first place?
They just went out with some girls. But it turns out one of them was the girlfriend of a gang leader. And he found out.
What are they thinking at a time like this?
Oh damn, he's pulling out a bat!
You little shit. You banged Misato, didn't you? Be honest now.
I didn't! Honestly, nothing like that ever happened!
You lying fuck! Misato told me the whole story! Don't try to weasel your way out of this!
Look, I didn't know she had a boyfriend! I'm sorry! Really!
You're the baseball team's ace, aren't you? I'm busting your hand for what you did. Bet it felt good squeezing Misato's titties!
No! Please, not that. Anything but that!
We have to stop them.
We can't take that many on! Besides, we're screwed either way. If they find out we were fighting, we'll be banned from Koshien!
Then we don't fight. But we have to save our guys.
Stop! Please, no more. Don't do this to them.
Mikasa!?
Who the fuck are you?
Please, just let our teammates go. They said they're sorry.

A little late for "sorry," asshole! Shoulda minded your own
damn business!
Argh! ...My arm!
Dude, are you all right!?
Hehehe, I know all about you little schoolboys. Get involved in any violence, and you can kiss your Koshien dreams goodbye.
So you can't take a swing at us, and you can't even call the cops because you don't want the attention.
Meaning we can do whatever we want, and you bitches have to suck it up and take it!
Hey. You guys need to stop. Now.
How's that arm, Mikasa-kun?
I... I don't know.
Get lost, geezer. You feel like getting your ass kicked, too?
Not in particular. But I don't like what I'm seeing here. I used to play high school ball myself.
Then fuck you too. It's these assholes' fault for messing with my girl.
And that gives you the right to beat on them? I don't think so.
That's it. I gave you a chance to walk away. Now you're gonna get shit-kicked with the rest of 'em!
(The dojo seems to be doin' well. Should be okay now.)
(Dunno when I'll see ya again, but hang tough, Sodachi. Keep the place goin'.)
(This place...)
(It's Sodachi Dojo, where I used to teach. Haven't seen the students or the dojo master, Sodachi, in a long while...)
(Who knows when I'll have another chance to see 'em again? I should drop in and say hello.)
Argghh! You remain the master, Saejima-san. You haven't lost your edge at all.
The edge is a little dull, but I keep the rust off. So, ya learn anythin'?
*pant* Not bad.
Look at you, Saejima-san. You took all of us on and held your own. I doubt anyone can beat you.
Yes! Thank you for the lesson!
Good, happy to hear it. Now, I gotta go.
Already? It would be nice if you could stay longer.
Haven't got much time, actually.
Don't worry about it. You take care.
You take care as well. I'll be here, so please drop by anytime. The students are always glad to see you.
Maybe... you could even train them...
No, don't count on that. I don't even know when I can make it out here again.
Oh... Are you going away somewhere?
Ya might say that. So try not to let the dojo go under while I'm gone.
Of course! I've committed to making both myself and the dojo stronger!
We will see you again some day, right?
Please try your best to come back! I might actually give you a challenge next time!
Sodachi Dojo's three principles!
One! What can be done today must be done by tomorrow at the latest!
Two! If it can't be done tomorrow, get it done the day after tomorrow for sure!
Three! If the day after tomorrow isn't possible, then really make sure that by the next⑬ Hm?
It's been so long, Saejima-san! Do you remember me? It's Sodachi! Wow, I remember back when you taught here. That was huge for us.
Yeah, it's been a while, Sodachi. Seems ya got a lot of students.
Oh, yes indeed. Your lessons made our boys tough, and our reputation started to spread. Everyone wants in, now.
Would you believe this? We're actually starting to make a little money. Hehe, it's yakiniku for me every night.
Eat some vegetables, too, eh? Still, good to hear the place is makin' it as a viable business.
There's so much to talk about. We should have tea! Do you have a little time?
...I see. A lot's happened.
Oh, yes. The five students you taught have all gone on to become successful in each of their fields.
And they're all still active in martial arts.
Good to hear. Makes it all worthwhile.
Yeah... Say, Saejima-san... Might I trouble you to conduct a session with our new students?
What, train them?
Yes. Every student you traded blows with made incredible gains.
If you could impart your teachings and passion to our new students, I'm sure it will spur great growth.
Master Saejima! Please teach us!
Well... All right. Just this once.
Thank you so much! Okay, everyone get ready!
Now, shall we?
What, you're fightin', too?
Of course. I need to set an example, don't I?
You should know... I've made some progress, too. Don't underestimate me!
Well. That, I gotta see.
Hehe. I'm really looking forward to this. No holding back, now!
Sure. All of ya, come at me together.
All right! Come on, warriors! We'll show this guy what's what!
Huh? Uh, yes, sir!
(Sodachi's turned into a proper dojo master. He'll keep the place safe. I'm countin' on ya, Sodachi.)
(Been a while. I wonder how Sodachi's doin'. Maybe I'll drop in on him.)
Urrggh...
(That's a Sodachi Dojo uniform!)
Hey! What happened to ya?
(Trouble? Gotta get to the dojo now!)
How did you do that? How strong can one man be?
Don't worry. You're about to find out.
Uh, looks like the gym project's delayed, indefinitely! Sorry to bother you gentlemen!
Sodachi!
Hey! Hang in there!
Saejima-san... I bit off a lot more than I can chew...
But it's okay. I just hope that when I'm reborn... I'll come back as someone who's as strong and cool as you...
Quit spoutin' nonsense! Talkin' ain't gonna help your injuries.
Please... tell the students... that they should carry on. And... and...
And...? What is it, Sodachi?
